hypotheses.name: Management credibility / promise-vs-delivery
hypotheses.construction: Per company, rolling score over trailing N (min 3) verifiable guidance commitments extracted by regex from concall transcripts (types: revenue, margin, capex, debt-reduction; order-book excluded, no fundamentals proxy exists). Each commitment matched to the PIT fundamentals observation with available_date > call_date within a +30d/+200d window; verdict = DELIVERED/PARTIAL/MISSED/unscored. Score = mean(DELIVERED=+1, PARTIAL=0, MISSED=-1) over scored commitments only, cross-sectionally demeaned within sector and quarter to remove base-rate/sector-cycle contamination.
hypotheses.expected_sign: positive: high-credibility (delivers) names earn higher forward abnormal returns than low-credibility (bluffer) names, sector-neutral
hypotheses.expected_horizon: near-zero at 1M, moderate at 1Y, dominant at 5Y (per concall_rubric.py HORIZON_EMPHASIS, pre-existing prior, not invented for this memo)

hypotheses.coverage_caveat: PILOT-SCALE ONLY. 139 usable tickers (zero overlap with the 264-name PDF set). Real cross-sectional backtest not feasible yet -- needs the 264-name PDF set OCR'd and date-parsed. Two P0 pipeline bugs found during self-red-team of the pilot: (1) no speaker attribution -- analyst QUESTIONS are currently being counted as management COMMITMENTS in some matches (verified example: AARTIIND Mar-2017 debt row is an analyst question, scored MISSED, incorrectly); (2) revenue-direction delivery scoring has a base-rate problem (most Indian companies grow revenue most quarters nominally, so DELIVERED is inflated without sector/index-relative demeaning). Neither fix is implemented yet -- illustrative pilot numbers (243 DELIVERED / 76 MISSED / 4 PARTIAL of 1,422 commitment-sentences across 25 tickers) must not be read as a scored signal.
hypotheses.priority: P1 -- distinct mechanism, structurally motivated by the prior tone-probe's null result, existing rubric infrastructure already 80% built; blocked on P0 extraction fixes before any IC/sleeve consideration

hypotheses.name: Repeated-miss bluff flag (penalty-only variant)
hypotheses.construction: Binary/count flag: number of consecutive trailing quarters with a MISSED verdict on the same commitment type (e.g. margin guidance missed 3 quarters running) -- a penalty-only red-flag signal (per concall_rubric.py's HORIZON_EMPHASIS 1M row: only the red-flag catch matters intraday-to-1M, positive dims don't).
hypotheses.expected_sign: negative: repeated-miss names underperform, effect concentrated shortly after the Nth miss becomes visible (available_date of the delivery-check quarter), fastest-acting of the two hypotheses
hypotheses.expected_horizon: 1M-1Y, fast-decaying (distinguish from W4M-01's slow reputational effect)
hypotheses.coverage_caveat: same pilot-scale and P0-fix caveats as W4M-01; additionally needs a company to have >=2 consecutive scored quarters on the SAME commitment type, which shrinks the usable pilot sample further (not yet counted -- flagged, not computed)
hypotheses.priority: P2 -- companion/robustness check to W4M-01, cheaper to test once P0 fixes land (binary flag needs less precision than the continuous credibility score)
